changes: The cue ball is an artistically generated Sun with animated photosphere, corona and prominence loops. Color intensity adjusted at runtime, Neptune blue-green rebalance, Earth cloud layering, compressed decorative rings and major moons. Source maps include enhanced color and reconstructed/unmapped regions. Every companion uses its own sourced image map. Pluto, Charon, Titania, Oberon, Triton and Deimos use AI artistic reconstructions of poorly resolved and missing terrain; other unobserved regions remain neutral; Charon presentation margins are removed. Number and stripe caps use the same artwork as Heads, projected onto curved patches that stay on the world-up face and show only during local human aiming. Moons orbit at exaggerated rates; the black-hole ball, animated disk, lensing arcs and glow are procedural illustrations, not a relativistic simulation. Ring density and spacing are exaggerated for play.
